content: This paper introduces a new methodology for selecting features and classifying functional data in healthcare applications, with a focus on scenarios with categorical responses and longitudinal features. The approach addresses optimization challenges by integrating logistic loss and functional features, utilizing functional principal components and an adaptive version of the Dual Augmented Lagrangian algorithm for computational efficiency in high-dimensional scenarios. The efficacy of the method is demonstrated through simulations and real data analysis on relationships between chronic diseases and other health and socio-demographic factors.
